author: btaylor
text:
My first job was at a gas station, where I cleaned bathrooms and pumped gas.

I earned $4.25/hr, and my shirt said “Brent” instead of “Bret.” Owner was too cheap to correct it.

Cleaning public bathrooms every day under someone else’s name was solid motivation to learn to code.

author: btaylor
text:
America’s flaws and incredible strengths are on display.

Our unwillingness to address even obvious gun reforms contributed to tragedy.

But in its wake we see the power of speech, of our youth, and of the free market to force change.

Our future will be brighter than our past. https://t.co/lSVWm5O1gD
